name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for speed and engineering. Growing up in Bangkok, he spent hours tinkering with engines and racing go-karts, fueling a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he gained valuable experience working for a local automotive firm, where he honed his skills in data analysis and performance optimization.

Driven by a desire to apply his expertise in a competitive environment, Somchai transitioned to motorsport, joining Opala Legends as a performance engineer. He approaches his work with a meticulous eye for detail, leveraging data to identify areas for improvement and collaborating closely with the drivers and mechanics to maximize the car's potential. His pragmatic approach and unwavering focus on results make him a valuable asset to the team.

Somchai distinguishes himself with his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. He is also a staunch believer in continuous learning, constantly seeking new ways to enhance his knowledge and stay ahead of the curve in the ever-evolving world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses to focus on the intricate data he analyzes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Thai iced coffee before every race.
